description: List the connected user's newest Skwirl saves, newest creation date first. Recent means the latest limit notes across all time, with no time window: limit is 1–20, default 5. Returns title, summary (up to 140 characters), note ID and saved date, or 'No matching saves.' Use for browsing recent additions; use search_skwirl for relevance, list_skwirl_mentions for named entities, and get_skwirl_note for a full note. Usage examples: recent_skwirl({"limit":5}); recent_skwirl({}). Returns text.

limit.description: Integer result count from 1 to 20; defaults to 5. Example: 5.

name: recent_skwirl
title: Browse recent saves
